name: Pawl
description: The pawl that drops into the tooth: a pivoted arm with its nose against the wheel.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8%; top: 38%; width: 76%; height: 24%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 78% 0, 100% 50%, 78% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 78% 0, 100% 50%, 78% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2%; top: 34%; width: 32%; height: 32%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 50%, #000 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 50%, #000 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
